name: Ziggurat
author: Erin Carter
description: One colossal raymarched stepped pyramid stands alone on a dark plain, terrace lips catching a knife-thin rim of light and a warm beacon burning at the summit. The camera rides a slow level orbit so near terraces slide across far ones in parallax while ground haze breathes around the base.

params.label: Orbit speed
params.effect: How fast the camera circles the pyramid.

params.label: Haze depth
params.effect: How high the ground haze pools up the lower tiers.

params.label: Beacon glow
params.effect: Brightness of the warm summit light and its halo in the haze.

params.label: Rim glow
params.effect: Strength of the thin lit lines along the terrace edges.
